The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: A 14th-century Tsalenjikha Cathedral fresco whose Commons description reports an identifying Georgian inscription naming St Nino, the enlightener of Georgia the folder keeps on 14 January. Commons describes it: A fresco depicting St. Nino, with the identifying Georgian inscription, from the Tsalenjikha Cathedral in Georgia. Painted by the Byzantine artist Cyrus Manuel Evgenikos in the period of 1384-1396. Discovered in 2018.
